description: Capture a real V8 heap memory snapshot, parse top object constructors & Detached DOM nodes, and detect memory leaks via baseline/diff comparison. Ordinary extension-debugger tabs return HEAPPROFILER_UNAVAILABLE instead of a metrics fallback; use an isolated DevTools context for native heap snapshots. Garbage collection is attempted before snapshot unless collectGarbage: false.

action.description: Memory action: 'baseline' (record a real heap baseline), 'diff' / 'check_leak' (compare against a real tab baseline), 'snapshot' (default), or 'gc' (trigger V8 GC only). Unsupported extension-debugger tabs fail clearly.

collectGarbage.description: Attempt V8 Garbage Collection before capturing a supported snapshot (default: true); GC failure does not fabricate a snapshot

compareWithBaseline.description: Compare this snapshot against the stored per-tab baseline to detect memory leaks

contextId.description: Optional isolated context; context tab IDs are negative

filePath.description: Required for isolated DevTools tabs; saves a real .heapsnapshot and enables baseline/diff comparison. Ordinary extension-debugger tabs do not support snapshots.

forceGC.description: Alias for collectGarbage: trigger V8 Garbage Collection before snapshot (default: true)

maxConstructors.description: Maximum number of top object constructors to return (default: 20)

recordBaseline.description: Explicitly save this snapshot as the new per-tab memory baseline
